_comment: Editorial content for CJPL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. This company has ceased manufacturing and is being wound up under a board- and shareholder-approved closure plan; products is empty deliberately, because listing jute goods it no longer makes would misstate its status.
description: Crescent Jute Products Limited is a Lahore-registered jute products company that has ceased manufacturing. Its board of directors and shareholders approved a closure plan, and management is implementing it in two parts: disposal of assets and a future business plan. The company reported a loss of Rs 3.50 million for the half year ended 31 December 2025, which it attributes to maintaining the minimum staff needed to manage its corporate and financial affairs.
headOffice: 1st Floor, 65-XX, Khayaban-e-Iqbal Road, Phase-III, DHA, Lahore 54792, Pakistan
sourceNote: Crescent Jute Products Limited condensed interim financial statements for the half year ended 31 December 2025 (company information and directors' report), filed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, read 2026-10-17.
